name: prediction-ledger
description: Prediction Ledger — import a video, extract the predictions it makes, generate an inspectable validation plan, research what actually happened, and keep a ledger of the results. Runs entirely on localhost.
author: Michael D. Carter (BitsBeTrippin) — original concept; built with Claude AI assistance

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-check.mjs && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
